Elevate your lifestyle with this exceptional townhome situated in an exclusive, upscale neighbourhood. Immerse yourself in the serene beauty of an expansive rooftop deck, perfect for entertaining or simply savouring the picturesque vistas where breathtaking water, city, and mountain views await. Step into the private master suite offers a retreat-like ambiance with its spacious layout, walk-in closet, and lavish bathroom featuring a soaker tub and separate shower. Maple hardwood floors and stylish glass railings enhance the home's elegance, while the gourmet kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances, ensures a seamless culinary experience.

Experience refined West Coast living in this custom Brandes luxury home, tucked in Point Grey’s coveted North of 4th. A reverse floor plan maximizes water views from the open-concept main floor featuring 11'+ vaulted ceilings. A private elevator connects all three levels, leading to a chef’s kitchen with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances, custom millwork, a wine cellar, and a private theater. Relax on the rooftop deck with a hot tub and panoramic ocean, mountain, and city views. Finished with stone, marble, and full home automation, this 4-bed, 5-bath unfurnished residence blends warmth and modern luxury steps from Spanish Banks, Jericho Beach, UBC, and top schools like Lord Byng. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.

Defined by high-performance sustainability & bespoke craft, the sun-lit main floor features a chef’s kitchen with integrated Miele appliances, custom millwork, & an oversized island. Upstairs, 3 bedrooms each enjoy a private ensuite with radiant in-floor heating, highlighted by a serene primary suite with a spa-inspired bath & WIC. The top level opens to a private balcony framing North Shore mountain & skyline views. Complete with 4 baths, central A/C, crawl space storage, & an EV garage. Steps from W 10th shops, cafes, top schools, UBC, Jericho Beach & Spanish Banks. If viewing on Zillow please text or email the leasing agent.
